from collections import defaultdict
from hashlib import sha256
from importlib.metadata import version
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time
from uuid import uuid4

import spicy_docs
from spicy_docs.sources.scorecards import get_adapter, validate_scorecard_bundle
from spicy_docs.sources.scorecards.common import ScorecardContext
from spicy_regs.etl_receipts import ReceiptContext, decode_exact_json, split_record, validate_receipt_row
from spicy_regs.scorecards.etl import POLICIES, SOURCE_NAMES, _witnesses
from spicy_regs.scorecards.registry import load_registry
from spicy_regs.scorecards.retained import RetainedScorecardBatch
from spicy_regs.scorecards.subject_shapes import map_source_row, restore_source_row


ROOT = Path.cwd()
F = ROOT.parent
CORPUS = F.parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/research/scorecards/work/integration/reader_adoption_modern_20261005.json'
PLAN = OUT.parent / 'modern_reader_plan_20261005.json'
plan = json.loads(PLAN.read_text())
assert version('spicy-docs') == '0.60.0'
assert Path(spicy_docs.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to((ROOT / '.venv').resolve())
assert set(SOURCE_NAMES) == set(POLICIES) - {'scorecard_member_links', 'scorecard_item_links'}
groups = defaultdict(list)
for entry in plan['entries']:
    groups[entry['edition']['publisher_id']].append(entry)
captures, semantic_inputs, scopes = [], [], []
started = time.perf_counter()
for publisher, entries in groups.items():
    def retain(document, body, *, stage):
        pin = sha256(body).hexdigest()
        assert pin in {entry.get('observations_sha256') for entry in entries}
        semantic_inputs.append({'publisher_id': publisher, 'source_sha256': sha256(document.body).hexdigest(), 'asset_sha256': pin, 'stage': stage})
        # Read-only replay uses the existing hash-pinned private asset in place.
        # The parent installed gate already qualified its private retention path.
        return {'observation_id': str(uuid4())}

    batch = RetainedScorecardBatch(CORPUS, entries, retain_observations=retain)

    def capture(response, **kwargs):
        captures.append({'publisher_id': publisher, 'url': response.requested_url, 'sha256': sha256(response.body).hexdigest(), 'stage': kwargs.get('stage')})
        return {'capture_id': str(uuid4())}

    context = ScorecardContext(batch, capture, max_requests=20)
    for edition in batch.list_scorecards(context):
        entry = batch.entries[edition.scorecard_id]
        adapter = get_adapter(entry['adapter'])
        installed = Path(adapter.__file__).resolve()
        assert installed.is_relative_to((ROOT / '.venv').resolve())
        assert sha256(installed.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == entry['reader_sha256']
        for relative, expected in entry.get('shared_source_dependencies', {}).items():
            dependency = installed.parents[2] / relative.removeprefix('src/spicy_docs/')
            assert sha256(dependency.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
        result = batch.for_edition(edition).acquire_scorecard(edition, context)
        tables = result.tables
        validate_scorecard_bundle(tables)
        assert set(tables) == set(SOURCE_NAMES)
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            policy = POLICIES[name]
            for index, raw in enumerate(rows):
                mapped = map_source_row(name, raw)
                subject, receipt = split_record(policy, mapped, ReceiptContext('consumer-modern-memory-check', f'{edition.scorecard_id}:{name}:{index}', policy.policy_version, _witnesses(raw)))
                validate_receipt_row(receipt, POLICIES)
                processing = decode_exact_json(receipt['processing_json'])
                restored = restore_source_row(name, (subject or {}) | processing)
                assert restored == raw, (edition.scorecard_id, name, index)
        scopes.append({'publisher_id': publisher, 'scorecard_id': edition.scorecard_id, 'counts': {name: len(rows) for name, rows in tables.items()}, 'complete_reference': 'PASS', 'all_source_fields_final_consumer_policy_roundtrip': 'PASS', 'reader_sha256': entry['reader_sha256']})
    batch.complete()
    assert len(batch.checked) == len(entries)

from spicy_docs.sources.scorecards import ADAPTER_PUBLISHERS
registry = load_registry()
assert {row.publisher_id for row in registry} == set(ADAPTER_PUBLISHERS.values())
for row in registry:
    if row.publisher_id in groups:
        assert row.enabled is False and row.historical_backfill is False
        assert row.evidence_policy == 'hash_only' and row.rights_status == 'unreviewed'

print(json.dumps({'scopes': scopes, 'captures': captures, 'private_semantic_inputs': semantic_inputs, 'all_source_rows_checked': sum(sum(scope['counts'].values()) for scope in scopes)}))
